name: smwgraphics-jungle-mountains
title: Jungle Mountains 2026
description:
A background of a jungle canopy vista with rocky mountains in the distance. Would go especially well in jungle or mountain levels. It was drawn as a contemporary revamp of this old background from 2009 while also drawing influence from this one from 2008, with more detailed and refined graphics.

It has a high tile usage (ideally takes up 3 GFX slots), but not only can it be worked around with only 2 slots at the expense of sacrifing the clouds, but you can also choose from 4 different included GFX setups for more efficient tile usage and better adaptation to your likings and needs. Refer to the readme file (named BG-SETUP-GUIDE.html) for guidance on that as well as any additional clarification.

Last but not least, it also includes three different palettes and a simple parallax HDMA effect, meant to be used with UberASM Tool, in case you want to add an extra layer of depth to it.

Credit is optional, but appreciated.
